name: Miscellanies, III
author: Cardinal Henry Edward Manning
desc: Miscellanies, volume III (1888): essays of 1880-88 on the Education Act of 1870, the Christianity of England, the parliamentary oath, St. Francis de Sales, W. G. Ward, the Salvation Army, emigration, the national vice, the Papacy and the Reformation, Henry VIII and the monasteries, the law of nature, the soul after death, and the Church its own witness.
desc_pt: Miscelânea, volume III (1888): ensaios de 1880-88 sobre a Lei da Educação de 1870, o cristianismo da Inglaterra, o juramento parlamentar, S. Francisco de Sales, W. G. Ward, o Exército da Salvação, a emigração, o vício nacional, o papado e a Reforma, Henrique VIII e os mosteiros, a lei natural, a alma antes e depois da morte e a Igreja testemunha de si mesma.
editor: Henry Edward Manning (London: Burns and Oates, 1888)
edition: Miscellanies (vol. 3) (London: Burns and Oates, 1888), Internet Archive full-text OCR.
srcnote: The essays, lectures and addresses in order; the contents, the publisher's list and the index are dropped.
